content:
Anita: Quick sync after the postmortem — we need concrete owners and short timelines for quota/backstop, scheduler knobs, headroom sims, and a recurring-pattern alert. Please claim a task.

Sam: I can take quota/backstop. Plan: temporary burst-credit namespace + permanent quota uplift request for critical services. Will open PR by Thu 09:30 PT and include gating by customer_tier.

Li: I9ll own scheduler tuning + canary. Two changes to test: reduce eviction grace to 90s for preemptible workers, and relax podSpread constraints that cause AZ hotspots. Staging canary Wed 22:00 PT.

Joel: I9ll run headroom simulations with traffic replays (last 6 weeks). Deliverable: heatmap + recommended safety multiplier. ETA next Tue EOD.

Maya: I9ll update the runbook and add a compact triage checklist (quota -> autoscaler throttles -> node fragmentation -> cache warms). Will add rollback steps for burst policy. ETA Mon morning.

Anita: infra-bot please create a tracker and add weekly reminders. Also, add a new alert: consecutive autoscaler throttles > 3 in 10m should page.

infra-bot: Created tracker INC-4801: "scaling-surge-action-listing" assigned to Sam, Li, Joel, Maya. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4801. Reminder: weekly sync Mon 09:00 PT.

Sam: policy note: gate burst by model_size; large-context jobs get no burst credits. I9ll include a matrix and examples in the PR.

Li: kube snippet I9ll test in staging:
```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: model-worker-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
```
Testing drain with `kubectl drain --grace-period=90 --ignore-daemonsets`.

Joel: telemetry add: emit rt.autoscaler.throttle with cluster,node_pool labels and a 1% KV warm header `X-KV-WARM:1`. Helps correlate cache cold starts.

Maya: draft alert for throttles:
expr: sum(increase(rt_autoscaler_throttle_total[10m])) by (cluster) > 3
for: 5m
labels: severity: page
I9ll link to the runbook.

Anita: owners + dates recap: Sam -> quota PR Thu 09:30 PT; Li -> scheduler staging canary Wed 22:00 PT; Joel -> headroom sims Tue EOD; Maya -> runbook Mon AM. I9ll run weekly rollups until INC-4801 is resolved.

Sam: posting PR plan later today.

Li: will post canary results to INC-4801 after staging run.

Joel: starting sims today; will attach notebook and plots.

Maya: first status sync scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. Ping here for blockers.

Anita: thanks team 97 appreciate the fast ownership. :thumbsup:
